items.html: And behold, after they descended there and all became Makif, then Bina and Gevura begin to enter first into the inner aspect of ZA, both of them in the Hod of Ima alone. Then the three sections of Hod spread throughout the entire left line of ZA; and from the last section, a moach of Bina is made for Malchut. And behold, when Bina and Gevura departed from ZA, as mentioned in the secret of the sleep, then they were shining in the Nukva Leah, in the aspect of Makifim; and from there it is drawn to the Malchut Rachel. And they are not asleep like ZA.
